metadata.title: घर पर बनी शराब के साथ स्वादिष्ट सिल्कवर्म | Handmade Wine and Silkworm |  Food of Assam
metadata.description:
Silk worm — a unique and popular tribal delicacy of Assam — holds a special place in the cuisine of the Bodo community. In this episode of Tribal Kitchen, Main Bhi Bharat editor Shyam Sunder travels to Bodoland to meet Haina Brahma, a champion tribal cook known for her traditional recipes. On our request, Haina prepared a delicious dish made from silk worms and offered a traditional Bodo drink that reflects the deep connection between food, nature, and culture in her community.

Join us on this flavorful journey into the heart of Bodoland, where every meal tells a story of tradition and pride.
